name: GPT-SoVITS
tagline: Few-shot voice cloning and multilingual text-to-speech studio runnable offline
real_test_summary: Cloned a 5-second English voice sample and synthesized clean 24kHz narration on an RTX 3060 12GB with ~3.8GB VRAM usage.
pros: 5-second instant voice cloning plus optional fine-tuning
Supports cross-lingual synthesis (English, Japanese, Chinese, Korean)
MIT open-source license with full WebUI
cons: WebUI has many training parameters for beginners
Requires 4GB+ NVIDIA VRAM for fast inference
description: Zero-shot and few-shot voice conversion and TTS framework capable of cloning natural timbre and prosody from a 5-second audio sample locally.
